qt: to the Commission Aldo Patriciello (PfE) Subject:

Projected fuel price hikes over the coming months threaten to add to the energy cost burden on households, businesses and the transport sector. They are expected to hit particularly hard over the winter season. At the same time, unyielding fiscal constraints could tie the hands of Member States in rolling out temporary relief measures for the public and in bolstering energy security and autonomy policies. In light of the above: 1.
Will the Commission allow for temporary derogations from the fiscal rules so that national governments can step in and tackle high fuel prices?
What measures will it adopt to support the energy policies of Member States?
